name: Kate Ebsworth
title: Principal Clinical Psychologist
description: Areas: depression, anxiety, trauma, relationships, work problems, pregnancy and parenting, adjustment, health and sexuality. I provide cognitive behaviour therapy (CBT), Eye Movement Desensitisation and Reprocessing (EMDR), Schema Therapy, Mindfulness, Interpersonal Neurobiology and Couples Therapy. I work in Heidelberg on Tuesdays, Thursdays, and Fridays.
specialties: trauma, EMDR, schema therapy, sexuality, couples, perinatal

name: Abigail Deodatus
title: Psychologist - Clinical Psychology Registrar
description: Anxiety, depression, development issues, trauma, relationships, work problems, adjustment, the Expat experience, stress management, neurodivergence/ADHD, bullying. I tend to curate evidence-based therapy such as CBT, ACT, and Schema Therapy to best suit each person's goals and needs.
specialties: trauma, schema therapy, expat adjustment, ADHD

name: Dr Laura Capitanio
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Depression, anxiety and trauma, sleep, parenting, childhood emotional and behavioural difficulties, ADHD, and adjustment to change. Draws on CBT, Schema Therapy, ACT and Positive Psychology. Works via Telehealth on Mondays, in Kew Tuesday-Thursday and in Heidelberg on Saturdays.
specialties: trauma, schema therapy, sleep, parenting, children

name: Martine Lynch
title: Psychologist - Clinical Psychology Registrar
description: I work with people presenting with issues including trauma, anxiety, parenting, childhood and adolescent emotional and behavioural difficulties, developmental trauma, body image, family violence, and coping with adjustment to life transitions. Works with children (5+), adolescents and adults.
specialties: trauma, developmental trauma, family violence, parenting

name: Lauren Maruff
title: Psychologist - Clinical Psychology Registrar
description: Depression, anxiety, trauma, grief and loss, adjustment and life transitions, neurodiversity, interpersonal relationships, sleep, women's health (incl fertility, PCOS, endometriosis, menopause). Works primarily with children (7+) and adults (17-35).

name: Dr Tania Miles
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Mood disorders, ASD, ADHD, OCD, relationship problems, grief, body image and eating disturbances, trauma, personality disturbance, parenting difficulties. I utilise CBT, Psychodynamic, Eye Movement Desensitisation and Reprocessing (EMDR), ACT with Mindfulness, systems, and am constantly learning and integrating.
specialties: trauma, EMDR, eating disorders, OCD, personality

name: Laura Murfett
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Anxiety, depression, stress, adjustment to change, trauma, parenting and childhood behavioural difficulties, new parenting adjustment, antenatal and birth anxiety; particular interest in disability and neurodivergence. Uses CBT, ACT and Schema Therapy.
specialties: trauma, schema therapy, perinatal, disability, neurodivergence

name: Elizabeth Solum
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Works with adolescents, adults, older adults, and those from the LGBTQIA+ community. Trauma (including complex trauma), grief and loss, depression, anxiety disorders and adjustment difficulties, Neurodivergence (ASD/ADHD). Key therapeutic techniques include Schema Therapy, ACT, EMDR, Narrative Therapy and CBT. (Elementa has Heidelberg and Kew clinics; bio does not specify which.)
specialties: LGBTQIA+, complex trauma, EMDR, schema therapy, neurodivergence

name: Dr Andrea Quah
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Depression, anxiety and trauma, parenting, childhood emotional and behavioural difficulties, ADHD, grief and loss, and adjustment to change in life circumstances. (Elementa has Heidelberg and Kew clinics; bio does not specify which.)
specialties: trauma, children and adolescents, parenting, grief

name: Dr Galit Hasen
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Anxiety, depression, relationship issues, trauma, grief and coping with adjustment to changes in life events; parenting and adjustment to the perinatal period. I work in Kew on Thursdays and via Telehealth on Wednesdays.

name: Naomi Heaps
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: I work with people suffering from historical developmental trauma (childhood abuse, neglect, bullying, sexual abuse/assault, injuries and accidents) using evidence-based trauma treatments such as EMDR and Schema Therapy to resolve PTSD, anxiety, depression, and phobias as well as problematic relational patterns. I enjoy working with a wide range of clients, particularly neurodiverse, LGBTQIA, and culturally diverse populations.
specialties: developmental trauma, PTSD, EMDR, schema therapy, LGBTQIA, neurodiverse, adolescents

name: Arpita Rapose
title: Clinical Psychologist
description: Depression, anxiety, stress, trauma, sleep, ASD, and ADHD; life challenges including work, health conditions, personality and relationships, and abuse. Works with adults and teens above 16 years; speaks Hindi. (Elementa has Heidelberg and Kew clinics; bio does not specify which.)
specialties: trauma, abuse, ADHD, body image, Hindi-speaking
